hero.title: Certified to Global Standards. Trusted by Global Brands.
hero.intro: At Kings International, compliance is embedded into every stage of manufacturing. Our internationally recognized certifications reflect our commitment to quality management, environmental responsibility, workplace safety, ethical manufacturing, and sustainable leather production - giving global buyers complete confidence in every partnership.
hero.imageAlt: Kings International's ZLD water treatment plant

cta.heading: Need compliance paperwork for your market?

certifications.title: ISO 9001 - Quality Management System
certifications.body: Ensuring consistent product quality, process control, customer satisfaction, and continual improvement throughout manufacturing.

certifications.title: ISO 14001 - Environmental Management System
certifications.body: Minimizing environmental impact through responsible resource management, pollution prevention, and sustainable operations.

certifications.title: ISO 45001 - Occupational Health & Safety
certifications.body: Providing a safe, healthy, and compliant workplace for every employee across our manufacturing facilities.

certifications.title: ISO 50001 - Energy Management System
certifications.body: Improving energy efficiency, reducing environmental impact, and supporting responsible industrial production.

certifications.title: SA 8000 - Social Accountability
certifications.body: Promoting ethical manufacturing through fair labor practices, worker welfare, human rights, and responsible workplace management.

certifications.title: Leather Working Group (LWG)
certifications.body: Responsible Leather Manufacturing- Recognizing best practices in environmental performance, traceability, and responsible leather production aligned with global industry expectations

certifications.title: MSME ZED Gold
certifications.body: Zero Defect Zero Effect- Recognizing excellence in product quality while promoting environmentally responsible manufacturing and operational efficiency.

certifications.title: REACH & ZDHC Compliance
certifications.body: Our leather is manufactured using REACH-compliant materials and ZDHC-aligned chemical management practices to meet stringent international environmental and product safety expectations.

whyCertified.title: Independently Audited
whyCertified.body: Every certification is issued and verified by accredited third-party certification bodies, ensuring transparency, credibility, and continuous compliance with international standards.

whyCertified.title: Buyer Compliance Ready
whyCertified.body: Complete certification documents, audit reports, scope details, and validity information are readily available to support customer due diligence, sourcing approvals, and retailer compliance requirements.

whyCertified.title: Continuously Maintained
whyCertified.body: Our management systems are regularly audited and renewed, ensuring ongoing compliance rather than one-time certification and supporting long-term manufacturing excellence.
